newsitem.title: FINLAND: KLEINWORT HAS BUY STANCE FOR TIETO - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: KLEINWORT HAS BUY STANCE FOR TIETO - PAPER.

text.p: Investment bank Kleinwort Benson rates Finnish data services group TT Tieto Oy as a buy in a fresh analysis, business daily Kauppalehti reported on Wednesday.

Kleinwort forecasts that TT Tieto's pretax profit would double this year to 196 million markka and rise further to 218 million markka in 1997 and to 242 million markka in 1998 from 96 million markka in 1995, Kauppalehti said.
TT Tieto was cheap compared to other European companies in the sector since its 1997 price to earnings ratio is about 15, while the sector's average is 24, it said.
